title: Eric A Probable NDE 6688
content: The experience happened between the time I first fell unconscious shortly after the overdose and three weeks later when I woke up in the hospital. I first remember being in the sky looking down through a hole in the clouds. I could see water, which I believed to be the Japan Sea. I could also see a plane floating which I believe had crash landed on the water. All of a sudden I was warped down to what I thought was the inside of the cabin of the plane. I was sitting in a row of seats. Inside the cabin, it was very bright. It was so bright I could not see the cabin walls nor could I make out specific details. What I did see was mostly shadows and forms. I knew I was sitting in a seat amongst rows of them. I felt a sudden impact and was propelled out of the seat and into an aisle. I landed on my back. I felt confused and disoriented feelings similar to having being concussed. My head was swirling. The seats melted away into the light. Everything was just light. I looked to my right and in the distance, I could see a ball of brighter light. Almost an opening, as if the light I was immersed in was emanating from this spot. In my mind, I thought this was the way out of the plane and I needed to get up and head toward the opening. Every time I tried to get up, I was knocked back down as if a force was holding me back. I tried several times but always with the same results. Ahead of me, I saw the forms of four people approaching me. I couldn't make them out, but I knew they were walking towards me. At first, I thought they were the stewards and stewardesses from the plane. Then I heard them say repeatedly to me, ‘Eric, we love you so much. Wake up now. Wake up because we love you, wake up.’ As they approached me and surrounded me, I saw them more closely. They had big and beautiful lidless eyes that were so full of love and compassion and eternity. Their faces quickly swirled around me and I saw them each and knew them. Even though in my mind I can still picture them clearly, I do not have the words to describe them fully. They were the most beautiful beings I ever saw and I realized they weren't human, but Angels. And not only angels, but they were Archangels, and I knew each of their names as if I had known them my whole life. Mich'l, Raph'l, Gabriel and Zadkiel. I was in complete awe as I looked up at them towering over me. I was still lying on my back. I wasn't scared. I felt comforted and happy. I no longer felt confused or disoriented and was able to sit up. At this point, I heard a fifth voice speak to me. A voice that was more powerful, even more loving and compassionate than the voices of the Angels. He lifted me up in his arms and I was completely filled with his light and his love completely. It was the most incredible feeling I have ever experienced and I didn't want to leave. Even though I couldn't see him I knew this was Jesus. He said to me, ‘This isn't your time; I still have plans for you. So wake up now Eric and know that I love you. I love you so much, so wake up now.’ He kept repeating these words until I did wake up. I was lying on a bed inside a hospital.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Warped down from the sky into what he thought was the inside of a plane cabin; later everything became light with an opening/ball of brighter light in the distance.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Suddenly 'warped down' into the plane cabin.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Identified a powerful loving voice/presence as Jesus, though he could not see him.
arrival.other_being_detail: Four beings identified as Archangels: Mich'l, Raph'l, Gabriel, and Zadkiel.

environment.environment_other_detail: Looked down through a hole in the clouds and saw water (believed Japan Sea) and a plane floating/crash-landed; later an extremely bright plane-cabin-like space where walls/details couldn't be seen; then everything was just light with a brighter opening/ball of light.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Jesus said, 'This isn't your time; I still have plans for you.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Plane-cabin-like setting that dissolved into all-encompassing light; repeated verbal urging to wake up.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like sky view and warping into a bright plane-cabin scene that dissolves into light; encounter with archangels and then Jesus; instructed to return and wakes in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Setting perceived as a crash-landed plane and being inside the cabin before it dissolved into light; identified four archangels by name (Mich'l, Raph'l, Gabriel, Zadkiel) with 'big and beautiful lidless eyes'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: ‘Eric, we love you so much. Wake up now. Wake up because we love you, wake up.’; ‘This isn't your time; I still have plans for you. So wake up now Eric and know that I love you. I love you so much, so wake up now.’
